actions.text:
Hi David —

I won’t send my Social Security number, DOB, or bank routing/account numbers in a chat message. For security and privacy I only share sensitive tax or banking details through verified, secure channels (for example, the platform’s verified payments/onboarding flow or via an authenticated company portal after I confirm the organization and contact). Please invoice me or process payment through FreelanceHub Payments, or provide a verified company email and a contract to sign (I can review and sign through the platform or a reputable e-sign provider). 

If this is a legitimate engagement, please share:
• A company contact email (company domain) and a brief verification (company website link and my point of contact),
• A written contract/statement of work and expected milestones, and
• The preferred invoicing/payment method via FreelanceHub or a verified payroll provider.

I’m happy to move forward once we’ve confirmed those details. I can also schedule a short call to finalize scope and payment terms. Thanks — Jordan Mitchell

actions.text:
Hi Marcus —

Thanks for reaching out and for the kind words about my React work. This project sounds like a great fit. A few quick questions so I can prepare a clear proposal:

• Can you share any API docs or a sample response so I can estimate integration effort? 
• Are there any specific charts or visualizations you need (e.g., time-series, histograms, heatmaps)? You mentioned D3.js — are you open to charting libraries like Recharts or Chart.js if they speed development?
• For authentication and RBAC, do you already have an auth provider (OAuth/JWT/OKTA/etc.) or should I implement a solution? 
• Do you have design mockups or brand guidelines for the UI and dark mode, or should I include basic UI/UX design in the scope? 
• Confirming budget/timeline: your $5–6k and ~4 weeks — is that fixed or flexible depending on scope? 

I’m available to start next month and can hop on a 30-minute call to finalize scope and milestones. Suggested times (CT): Tuesday or Thursday 10:00–12:00 or Friday 14:00–16:00 — let me know what works or share your availability.

I can prepare a short proposal with milestones and a firm quote once I have the API and your priorities. We can contract and process payments via FreelanceHub Payments or your preferred corporate flow.

Looking forward to hearing more —

Jordan Mitchell
ML Engineer / Full-Stack Dev
